verdict.rationale: The evidence covers consent state, CCPA data-sale opt-out and consent-based forwarding rules. These are adjacent privacy controls, not retention or deletion. The GDPR/CCPA compliance item is only a title with no mention of retention periods, erasure requests or deletion APIs. A customer data platform could reasonably offer these controls, so the axis applies, but nothing in the pack shows it does.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
